_note: Stage 3: reference scores made by re-reading each response in responses.txt and re-scoring it row by row against the euro-v1 row definitions (checklist), separately from the stage-1 design. Written by the same agent that wrote the responses (NOT an independent human rater) and NOT passed to any grading call. 'range' = acceptable total range (interpretations a reasonable rater could defend); 'ambiguous' lists rows where a reasonable rater could differ by one point; 'designDiff' lists rows where this reference differs from the stage-1 design. status: agreed | ambiguous_kept | excluded (excluded rows are left out of accuracy aggregates and reported separately). Row order: DBQ thesis,context,docs,outside,sourcing,complexity | LEQ thesis,context,evidence,analysis | SAQ a,b,c.
